stories.headline: Anthropic Accidentally Leaks Claude Code's 512K-Line Source Code via Misconfigured npm Package

key_facts.fact: A 59.8 MB JavaScript source map file was inadvertently included in version 2.1.88 of the @anthropic-ai/claude-code npm package, exposing approximately 512,000 lines of TypeScript across ~1,900 files.
key_facts.excerpt: A 59.8 MB JavaScript source map file (.map), intended for internal debugging, was inadvertently included in version 2.1.88 of the @anthropic-ai/claude-code package on the public npm registry.

key_facts.fact: Anthropic confirmed the leak was 'a release packaging issue caused by human error, not a security breach' and said no sensitive customer data or credentials were exposed.
key_facts.excerpt: Anthropic leaked part of the internal source code for its popular artificial intelligence coding assistant, Claude Code, the company confirmed on Tuesday.

key_facts.fact: The leaked source revealed internal codenames: Capybara (Mythos) for a Claude 4.6 variant already at v8, Fennec for Opus 4.6, and Numbat as an unreleased model still in testing.
key_facts.excerpt: The leak confirms that Capybara is the internal codename for a Claude 4.6 variant, with Fennec mapping to Opus 4.6 and the unreleased Numbat still in testing.

key_facts.fact: The code revealed a 'Self-Healing Memory' architecture, a three-layer memory system using lightweight pointers and on-demand topic files rather than traditional store-everything retrieval.
key_facts.excerpt: The leaked source reveals a sophisticated, three-layer memory architecture that moves away from traditional 'store-everything' retrieval.

key_facts.fact: The source revealed a KAIROS feature flag (mentioned 150+ times) for an autonomous daemon mode that allows Claude Code to operate as an always-on background agent performing memory consolidation.
key_facts.excerpt: KAIROS represents a fundamental shift in user experience: an autonomous daemon mode. While current AI tools are largely reactive, KAIROS allows Claude Code to operate as an always-on background agent.

key_facts.fact: Claude Code has achieved an annualized recurring revenue of $2.5 billion, more than doubling since the beginning of the year, with enterprise adoption accounting for 80% of its revenue.
key_facts.excerpt: Market data indicates that Claude Code alone has achieved an annualized recurring revenue (ARR) of $2.5 billion, a figure that has more than doubled since the beginning of the year.

key_facts.fact: A clean-room Python reimplementation of the leaked code (claw-code) hit 44,500 GitHub stars within hours, raising questions about DMCA-proof derived works created by AI agents.
key_facts.excerpt: Gergely Orosz argued that the leaked TS source was rewritten in Python via OpenAI's Codex in hours, creating a DMCA-proof derived work that cannot be taken down. The claw-code repo hit 44,500 stars.

stories.headline: Google Warns Quantum Computers Could Break Crypto Encryption With 20x Fewer Qubits Than Expected

key_facts.fact: Google Quantum AI published a whitepaper showing elliptic curve cryptography protecting Bitcoin, Ethereum, and most cryptocurrencies could be broken with fewer than 500,000 physical qubits, down from roughly 9-10 million previously estimated — a 20-fold reduction.
key_facts.excerpt: They achieved this using fewer than 1,200 logical qubits and around 90 million Toffoli gate operations, which roughly represents a 20-fold reduction in the quantum resources previously thought necessary.

key_facts.fact: The attack could be executed in minutes on a sufficiently powerful quantum machine. Under idealized conditions, a primed quantum computer has a roughly 41% probability of deriving a private key before a Bitcoin transaction is confirmed.
key_facts.excerpt: Under idealized conditions, Google estimates a roughly 41% probability that a primed quantum computer could derive a private key before a Bitcoin transaction is confirmed.

key_facts.fact: In an unprecedented move, Google chose not to publish the actual circuits, instead releasing a zero-knowledge proof that lets researchers verify the claims without reproducing the attack. This was developed in coordination with the US government.
key_facts.excerpt: Google chose not to publish the actual quantum circuits behind their newest estimates, instead releasing a zero-knowledge proof: a cryptographic technique that lets independent researchers verify that the claims are mathematically sound.

key_facts.fact: The paper was co-authored with Justin Drake of the Ethereum Foundation and Dan Boneh of Stanford. It is the third major quantum threat paper in twelve months, following Gidney's RSA paper and Iceberg Quantum's Pinnacle architecture.
key_facts.excerpt: Google Quantum AI published a whitepaper with co-authors including Justin Drake of the Ethereum Foundation and Dan Boneh of Stanford.

key_facts.fact: Google has set a 2029 internal deadline for its own post-quantum cryptography migration, a signal that carries particular weight given its own researchers produced these estimates.
key_facts.excerpt: The news comes just days after Google moved up its timeline for transitioning to post-quantum cryptography, setting a 2029 target after faster-than-expected advances in quantum computing.

stories.headline: OpenAI Ships Official Codex Plugin for Rival Anthropic's Claude Code

key_facts.fact: OpenAI open-sourced a plugin under Apache 2.0 that installs directly inside Anthropic's Claude Code, adding slash commands for code reviews, adversarial reviews, and task delegation to Codex.
key_facts.excerpt: OpenAI published a Codex plugin on March 30 that installs directly inside Anthropic's Claude Code, letting developers run code reviews and delegate tasks to Codex without leaving their existing workflow.

key_facts.fact: The plugin provides six slash commands including /codex:review for standard reviews, /codex:adversarial-review for challenge reviews questioning implementation decisions, and /codex:rescue for full task delegation.
key_facts.excerpt: /codex:review runs a standard read-only Codex code review. /codex:adversarial-review adds a steerable challenge mode. /codex:rescue hands work off to Codex entirely.

key_facts.fact: The move reflects competitive dynamics: Claude Code leads developer adoption with a $2.5B annualized run rate and 135,000 daily GitHub commits, while Codex has reached 1.6 million weekly active users.
key_facts.excerpt: Claude Code contributed to a $2.5 billion annualized run rate for Anthropic and generates 135,000 daily commits on GitHub. Codex has reached 1.6 million weekly active users.

key_facts.fact: A same-day vulnerability disclosure revealed a critical command injection flaw in Codex via manipulated branch names, potentially exposing GitHub OAuth tokens. OpenAI patched the issue.
key_facts.excerpt: Phantom Labs disclosed a critical vulnerability in Codex itself. The flaw allowed command injection through manipulated branch names during task creation, potentially exposing GitHub OAuth tokens.

stories.headline: North Korean Hackers Compromise Axios npm Package in Supply Chain Attack Affecting Millions

key_facts.fact: Malicious versions of the axios npm package (1.14.1 and 0.30.4) were published via a hijacked maintainer account, injecting a remote access trojan targeting macOS, Windows, and Linux. The package has over 300 million weekly downloads.
key_facts.excerpt: A suspected North Korean hacker has hijacked and modified a popular open source software development tool to deliver malware that could put millions of developers at risk.

key_facts.fact: Google attributed the attack to UNC1069, a suspected North Korean financially-motivated threat actor that Google covered in a February blog post.
key_facts.excerpt: Hackers connected to North Korea are responsible for the recent compromise of a wildly popular library.

key_facts.fact: The malicious versions were live for approximately 2-4 hours before npm unpublished them. Cognition's Devin caught the attack for customers within one hour of injection.
key_facts.excerpt: Live for ~2-4 hours before npm unpublished them. Cognition's Devin Review caught the attack for customers within an hour.

key_facts.fact: The axios attack occurred hours before the Claude Code source leak, and the leaked Claude Code codebase itself was found to use the compromised axios package.
key_facts.excerpt: The most immediate danger is a concurrent, separate supply-chain attack on the axios npm package, which occurred hours before the leak.

stories.headline: Google Warns Quantum Computers Could Crack Crypto Encryption With 20x Fewer Resources

key_facts.fact: Google Quantum AI published a whitepaper estimating that a quantum computer with fewer than 500,000 physical qubits could break Bitcoin's 256-bit elliptic curve cryptography, a roughly 20-fold reduction from prior estimates in the millions.
key_facts.excerpt: The paper estimates that a quantum computer with fewer than 500,000 physical qubits could break Bitcoin's 256-bit elliptic curve cryptography, a roughly 20-fold reduction from prior estimates that hovered in the millions.

key_facts.fact: The researchers compiled two optimized quantum circuits for Shor's algorithm: one using fewer than 1,200 logical qubits with 90 million Toffoli gates, and another with fewer than 1,450 logical qubits with 70 million Toffoli gates.
key_facts.excerpt: Google's researchers compiled two optimized quantum circuits implementing Shor's algorithm for the elliptic curve discrete logarithm problem (ECDLP-256): one using fewer than 1,200 logical qubits with 90 million Toffoli gates, and another using fewer than 1,450 logical qubits with 70 million Toffoli gates.

key_facts.fact: A quantum attacker could derive a Bitcoin private key in approximately 9 minutes once a transaction is broadcast, just under the typical 10-minute block confirmation window, giving about a 41% success rate.
key_facts.excerpt: Google's analysis suggests that once a Bitcoin transaction is broadcast and a private key exposed on-chain, a quantum attacker could derive the private key and hijack the transaction in approximately nine minutes.

key_facts.fact: Roughly 6.9 million BTC sit in addresses where public keys have been exposed, including about 1.7 million from Bitcoin's early years, making them vulnerable to quantum attacks.
key_facts.excerpt: Google's research identified roughly 6.9 million BTC already sitting in addresses where public keys have been exposed, including approximately 1.7 million from Bitcoin's early years.

key_facts.fact: A simultaneous Caltech/Oratomic paper on arXiv shows neutral-atom quantum computers could execute similar attacks with as few as 10,000 physical qubits, 50x more efficient than Google's estimate.
key_facts.excerpt: A simultaneous paper from Caltech and quantum startup Oratomic demonstrates that neutral-atom quantum computers could execute similar attacks with as few as 10,000 physical qubits, or roughly 50 times more efficient than Google's superconducting-qubit estimate.

key_facts.fact: Google released the research using a zero-knowledge proof to verify the circuits exist without revealing implementation details, signaling the seriousness of the threat.
key_facts.excerpt: Google released its research using a novel disclosure method: a zero-knowledge proof verifying the quantum circuits exist without revealing implementation details.

stories.headline: FDA Approves Corcept's Lifyorli for Platinum-Resistant Ovarian Cancer, First Selective SGRA

key_facts.fact: The FDA approved Lifyorli (relacorilant) in combination with nab-paclitaxel for adults with platinum-resistant epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal cancer, making it the first FDA-approved selective glucocorticoid receptor antagonist.
key_facts.excerpt: Lifyorli is the first FDA-approved selective glucocorticoid receptor antagonist (SGRA). It competitively binds to the glucocorticoid receptor (GR), where it enhances chemotherapy sensitivity by inhibiting cortisol's suppression of apoptosis.

key_facts.fact: In the pivotal ROSELLA trial, patients treated with Lifyorli plus nab-paclitaxel experienced a 35% reduction in risk of death compared to nab-paclitaxel alone, with median overall survival of 16.0 months vs 11.9 months.
key_facts.excerpt: patients treated with Lifyorli in addition to nab-paclitaxel experienced a 35% reduction in the risk of death compared to patients treated with nab-paclitaxel alone, with a median overall survival (OS) of 16.0 months, compared to 11.9 months.

key_facts.fact: Patients also saw a 30% reduction in risk of disease progression as assessed by blinded independent central review.
key_facts.excerpt: Patients who received Lifyorli in addition to nab-paclitaxel also experienced a 30% reduction in the risk of disease progression, as assessed by blinded independent central review (PFS-BICR).

key_facts.fact: Corcept CEO Dr. Joseph Belanoff said the approval demonstrates the potential of cortisol modulation in oncology.
key_facts.excerpt: It is a privilege to bring forward a new treatment for patients who historically have had few options. We have worked for years to demonstrate the potential of cortisol modulation in oncology.

stories.headline: Autonomous Warship Startup Saronic Raises $1.75B at $9.25B Valuation for Naval Fleet

key_facts.fact: Saronic raised $1.75 billion in Series D funding led by Kleiner Perkins, more than doubling its valuation to $9.25 billion from $4 billion after a $600 million raise in early 2025.
key_facts.excerpt: The round, led by Kleiner Perkins, more than doubles Saronic's valuation to $9.25 billion from the $4 billion it hit after a $600 million raise early last year.

key_facts.fact: Saronic plans to build more than 20 autonomous ships per year by 2027 and is potentially building a new shipyard called 'Port Alpha' in Texas.
key_facts.excerpt: Saronic plans to use the funding to scale its supply chain and shipyards, and build more than 20 ships a year by 2027.

key_facts.fact: The company's main shipyard in Franklin, Louisiana is undergoing a $300 million expansion, and Saronic says it is on pace to quintuple production there over the next 12 months.
key_facts.excerpt: Saronic's main shipyard in Franklin, Louisiana, is currently undergoing a $300 million expansion. Mavrookas said the company is on pace to quintuple production there over the next 12 months.

key_facts.fact: Saronic last year signed a $392 million Navy contract. The Iran war and Strait of Hormuz bottleneck are driving urgent demand for unmanned naval systems.
